encoding: UTF-8 canonical JSON array with typed fields and sorted object keys
branch_transition_index: action_ordinal*10000000 + family_ordinal*1000000 + entity_ordinal; each term below multiplier; never runtime draw count
uniform: unsigned big-endian first 8 digest bytes divided by 2^64
categorical_rule: first cumulative probability strictly greater than U; final-category floating tail fallback
